connector.name: Bareun - Korean NLP & Spell/Grammar Checking
connector.registryDescription: Korean NLP MCP server: morphological analysis, tokenization, spell & grammar checking (Bareun)
connector.summary: Hosted at api.bareun.ai over streamable HTTP. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace ai.bareun, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Send 'Bearer <your Bareun API key>'. Alternatively send the key in an 'api-key' header. Get a key at https://bareun.ai.
